name: supademo
description: Backend-first Supabase reference SaaS. Frontends land in apps/ later.
//: Bun is the JavaScript toolchain for packages/ and apps/. supabase/functions is Deno's — the Supabase Edge Runtime is a Deno fork and those files use Deno.serve, EdgeRuntime.waitUntil and Supabase.ai. Neither runtime has to be installed: both are pinned in scripts/toolchain.lock and fetched on demand. Backend work needs neither.
